description.en: Sinosauropteryx prima: whole living environment prop. Nominal 0.6m. Slender short-armed whole organism with very long low filament-fringed tail, based on Bristol2017 NIGP127586 fossil and interpretive drawing. Exact bulk, coat density, warm brown/cream hue, ring spacing, pose, digits and lips artistic. Nicholls image restoration not direct fossil proof.
description.zh: Sinosauropteryx风格化完整活体环境道具；软组织、姿态、颜色与名义尺度含艺术解释，并非精确标本。
